title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Clear, distant recording that's among the better versions of this show, but the performance is only average.
ai_review.review: The flac24 file is praised for its depth and clarity – listeners note it as one of the higher‑quality sources available, despite a slightly remote soundstage. Musically, the concert isn’t highlighted as a standout night; reviewers describe the playing as competent but not especially inspired. A missing track in the accompanying mp3 zip detracts from the overall package.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged average (no standout moments, modest playing) while recording quality is considered good to excellent; weighting yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as distant-sounding yet clear with depth; noted as one of the better versions available, though a missing track in the mp3 zip is mentioned.
